newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOT-Mitsubishi posts 217.9 bln yen appraisal loss.
newsitem.headline: BOT-Mitsubishi posts 217.9 bln yen appraisal loss.

text.p: Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd said on Wednesday it posted an appraisal loss of 217.9 billion yen on its securities holdings in the fiscal year that ended on March 31.
The bank said, however, it does not expect its business results for 1996/97 to vary significantly from the current forecast.
The bank also said that despite the appraisal loss in 1996/97, it still had overall unrealised profit on its securities holdings of 1.65 trillion yen as of the end of March.
